description: subscribe.ts has inconsistent step numbering comments. Line 53 says 'Step 3: planId validation' but line 67 also says 'Step 3: Upsert provisional member row'. Line 58 says 'Step 2 (advisory lock)' while 'Step 2' at line 37 is link session validation. This creates confusion when mapping code to the 14-step sequence in the spec. Functionally the ordering is correct per REQ-BILL-011, but the comment numbering is wrong and will cause maintenance confusion.
